46K likes, 154 comments - nicolaalexis_ on July 23, 2026: "🍑 Easy Apricot & Blueberry Cake

There’s something about baked apricots that makes a simple cake feel extra special. Add a handful of blueberries, a crunchy almond topping, and you’ve got one of those recipes you’ll want to make again before summer is over.

I used a mild fruity olive oil (Arbequina), which keeps the cake beautifully moist. If you prefer, you can swap it for 100 g melted butter.

──────────

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

90 ml mild olive oil (or 100 g melted butter)
80 g caster sugar
2 eggs
170 g plain Greek yogurt
1 tsp vanilla extract
200 g plain flour
1½ tsp baking powder
Pinch of salt

350 g apricots, chopped
150 g blueberries

For the topping

20 g brown sugar
20 g flaked almonds
¼ tsp cinnamon
¼ tsp cardamom

──────────

HOW TO MAKE IT

Whisk together the eggs, sugar, olive oil, yogurt and vanilla. Fold in the flour, baking powder and salt, then gently stir through the apricots and blueberries.

Pour into a 20 cm (8-inch) cake tin. Mix the topping ingredients together and sprinkle over the cake.

Bake at 180°C / 350°F for 45–50 minutes until golden.".

audio.transcript: I'm going to show you how to make a simple and delicious pasta dish. First, we need to cook the pasta. Bring a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil. Add about 200 grams of your favorite pasta, like spaghetti or penne. Cook according to the package directions until al dente, which means it should still have a slight bite to it. While the pasta is cooking, let's prepare the sauce. In a separate pan, heat about two tablespoons of olive oil over medium heat. Add one finely chopped garlic clove and sauté until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Be careful not to burn the garlic. Now, add one can of crushed tomatoes, about 400 grams. Stir in half a teaspoon of dried oregano, a pinch of red pepper flakes for a little heat, and salt and pepper to taste. Bring the sauce to a simmer and let it cook for about 10 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld together. Once the pasta is cooked, drain it well, reserving about half a cup of the pasta water. Add the drained pasta directly to the sauce. Toss everything together to coat the pasta evenly. If the sauce seems a little too thick, add a splash of the reserved pasta water to loosen it up. Continue to toss until the sauce reaches your desired consistency. Finally, serve immediately, garnished with fresh basil leaves and a sprinkle of grated Parmesan cheese, if desired. Enjoy your homemade pasta!
